annotations.text:
Direction A - warm editorial.
Newsreader for titles, Karla for UI, paprika accent with an olive second colour for the "you have this" state.
B and C below are the alternates if you'd rather go denser or more photo-led.
Checking things here is what powers the "Only what I can make" toggle on Home. Ingredients are matched on lowercased name, so "Garlic" and "garlic" are the same row.
Reached from the sliders button in the Home header. The appearance choice is stored on the phone, so it survives a restart and does not follow the system unless you ask it to.

Regenerate the launcher assets with scripts/build-icons.sh after changing the mark. The geometry lives in three places that must move together: design/logo.svg, the build script, and src/components/logo.tsx.
